phase_0.boundary_condition: The terminal anchor ⊣ encloses the full IMASM word fusion cycle, bounding the inter-IMASM interface where scale-collapse dimensionality (𐑦) carries the bulk content losslessly across the boundary.

⊢.justification: Initializes the empty state before any inter-IMASM word fusion hotswap is named or established.

⊣.justification: Closes and contains the entire fusion process as the hermetic vessel seal of the system.

≻.justification: Represents the ascent or growth cycle of the hotswap fusion, propagating constraint through the scale-collapse boundary.

≺.justification: Models the descent or solve/coagula phase, reversing direction to reintegrate fused components.

⋈.justification: Chains sequential transformations in the hotswap fusion, linking morphisms and evaluators in order.

⊙.justification: Self-reference of the fused word, ensuring the system recognizes itself as the same program after hotswapping.

∈.justification: Splits the fusion process into two arms: one for constructive truth (T) and one for constructive falsity (F), enabling parallel evaluation.

∋.justification: Rejoins the T and F arms of the fusion, recovering the original input structure through transformed reconnection.

⊤.justification: Affirms the constructive success state of the hotswap fusion on the T-arm.

⊥.justification: Refutes the failure state of the hotswap fusion on the F-arm.

⊞.justification: Holds both T and F simultaneously during the hotswap fusion, maintaining a contradiction without resolution.

⊡.justification: Permanently records the fused word state as an append-only, irreversible measurement.
